roleZh: 连接芯片与衬板、衬板与底板，并提供导热路径。
roleEn: Joins dies to substrates and substrates to the baseplate, providing thermal paths.
featuresZh: 模型分离薄层以便观察；空洞、界面与疲劳影响不能从此几何中推断。
featuresEn: Thin layers are separated for visibility. Voids, interfaces and fatigue cannot be inferred from this geometry.
materialZh: 示例为无铅焊料；银烧结是可选的不同连接工艺。
materialEn: Lead-free solder in this example; silver sintering is a distinct alternative joining process.
